statement: Every explicit U gives a valid norm-and-box task bound; a rational feasible center plus null-history perturbations can exhibit two compatible operators with separated task values. Search failure alone proves neither impossibility nor uniqueness.

body: Set L=B^-1, R=BH-I, C=BY-F and M=B^-T W. Exact algebra gives <W,H>=Tr(M)+<U,C>+<M-UF^T,R>-<B^T U,E>. Spectral/nuclear duality and each response box bound the last two terms. Round proposed multipliers/factors to rationals and enclose residual norms upward. For a negative certificate, verify H0=B^-1(I+R0) lies in every box with ||R0||<rho; choose exact V^T F=0 and bounded rational J,V. Then R0±aJV^T remains in the ball for the displayed slack allowance and preserves all old full responses, while its task separation lower-bounds unavoidable error in this information class. A better acquired source model may exclude both alternatives.
